name: agent-kit
description: Beau Lyddon's portable skills and plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, pi, OpenCode and other Agent Skills / Agent Plugins clients.

plugins.name: essentials
plugins.description: Everyday engineering skills that work in any agent, for commit messages, cross-tool session handoffs, grilling a plan before you act on it, sharpening a task to be deeper instead of bigger, and being tutored to mastery of a topic.

plugins.name: eng-leadership
plugins.description: Skills for engineering leaders, for design/RFC reviews and structured interview kits.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Up-to-date library and API documentation lookup via the Context7 MCP server, with a no-MCP fallback.

plugins.name: principles
plugins.description: Twenty-four named engineering principles (prove it works, fix root causes, subtract before you add, build the lever, and more) that steer how agents design, build and verify, plus a benchmark checklist. One skill with one file per principle.

plugins.name: bstack
plugins.description: Beau's rigorous agent workflow. beau-mode routes each task to a playbook and the principles; beau-help lists what the kit can do and what's new; waiting-on-me lists what waits on you across your repos; parallel-next finds the next planned work that won't collide with other sessions and starts the items you pick, each in its own beau-mode session; skills for understanding (how, why, teach, recall), debugging (root-cause finds a bug's cause from facts, not from reading the code), proof (verify-work, create- and maintain-verification-skill, create- and maintain-formal-verification-skill, swarm), design and planning (architect, arena, state-machines, technical-writing), product repos (scaffold-product and the Product phase playbook), review and trails (interrogate, show-me-your-work), closing out (debrief keeps a checked change record per PR and prints the brief and the release notes), improvement (reflect, correct, unslop, no-comments), and test economics (qualitydirector records per-test time and outcome, books the runs into the quality books, checks them and summarizes a week; local-ci runs a repo's CI on this machine and posts it to the PR as a commit status) do the steps. Adapted from Lauren Tan's pstack to work in any agent.

plugins.name: cfo
plugins.description: A CFO for AI and cloud spending. Keeps a private cost ledger from receipts and provider billing data, separates cash cost from API-equivalent cost, estimates runs before they start, writes a weekly brief, and proposes budgets and cuts for you to approve. Never pays, cancels or deletes anything itself.

plugins.name: video
plugins.description: Narrated explainer videos made by your agent, from concept and script through voiceover and animation to a checked MP4. Renders with Remotion, whose agent skills it relies on.
